title: numu CC0pi Np (pmu 1.5-20 GeV/c, thmu<20 deg, 0.45<pp<1.2 GeV/c, thp<70 deg) dsigma/d(dpT): transverse momentum imbalance [GeV/c]
motivation: Model v5 has a global relativistic Fermi gas (k_F=221 MeV/c) CCQE, RS17 2p2h with an np-dominated pair final state and an Oset-type nucleon cascade. The corpus constrains the QE sector only through muon kinematics, SumTp and Eavail, where LFG+RPA, a spectral function, RPA alone and a stiffer axial form factor are degenerate. STKI of the leading proton in CC0pi Np separates the initial-state nucleon momentum (dpT/pn peak, Fermi edge) from intranuclear momentum transfer by 2p2h and proton FSI (dpT tail, dalphaT slope); no proton-angle or muon-proton correlation observable exists in the corpus.
